expectations.text: Uses InfoTip or ToolTip from @codecademy/gamut rather than a custom hover popup
expectations.evidence: Reuses IconButton, which composes ToolTip internally via its tip/tipProps props -- no custom popup markup at all.

expectations.text: Does not manually wire onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave plus a custom absolutely-positioned div
expectations.evidence: No mouse handlers or custom positioning; fully delegated to IconButton/ToolTip.

expectations.text: Does not reimplement focus-triggered accessibility by hand
expectations.evidence: No hand-rolled focus/aria logic beyond the aria-label default.

expectations.text: Accessible name/description wiring follows the documented InfoTip/ToolTip pattern
expectations.evidence: aria-label defaults sensibly to hint text, overridable; tip/tipProps wired exactly per IconButton's real API.

needs_review: This is the simpler and more idiomatic of the two implementations for this eval -- reuses IconButton's existing tip/tipProps composition instead of hand-building a styled(Box)+ToolTip wrapper. No TS errors surfaced here (unlike the with_skill run for this same eval, which has real compile errors -- see its grading notes).
